title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing degree in CS or STEM discipline; experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go.
description: Software Engineering Interns work on core search products, infrastructure, and machine learning tools across Google teams.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom pursuing a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership capacity, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Full-cost scholarship covering tuition, living allowance, and travel costs for outstanding international applicants to study at Cambridge.

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Remote
eligibility: Open to applicants with 1+ years of professional software development experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS/CE or equivalent; experience with React, TypeScript, C#, and Azure.
description: Join Microsoft Cloud Platform team to design and implement scalable full-stack microservices supporting global enterprise customers.

title: Associate Programme Management Officer (YPP)
eligibility: 32 years of age or younger with a first-level university degree and nationality of a participating country.
qualification: Bachelor's degree relevant to Administration, Economics, or International Relations.
description: Entry-level recruitment program for talented young professionals to start an international civil service career at the UN.

title: OpenAI Technical Residency Program
eligibility: Self-taught developers, researchers, or STEM degree holders looking to transition into AI research.
qualification: Strong programming foundation (Python/C++), advanced math skills, and passion for AI safety.
description: 6-month full-time residency offering a guided pathway into top-tier artificial intelligence and deep learning research.

title: Kaggle Global Data Science Challenge
eligibility: Open to all students, data scientists, and developers worldwide.
qualification: Proficiency in Python, Machine Learning, and Computer Vision / NLP libraries.
description: Compete against global machine learning developers to create high-accuracy predictive models for real-world datasets.
